packageRules.description: Cooldown before automerge picks up a release: a hijacked package is usually spotted and yanked within days. digest is in here because a digest-only update means an upstream tag moved onto another commit. vulnerabilityAlerts overrides this, so CVE fixes still land at once
Automerge all safe updates (minor/patch/digest) via PR once CI passes
Minor SwiftPM bumps ship in the binary and the app
Patch/digest SwiftPM bumps ship in the binary and the app
Actions, runner labels and CI tools do not ship in the product

customManagers.description: Tools pinned as plain env vars in the workflows (SwiftLint, SwiftFormat, XcodeGen, actionlint), which no built-in manager sees
